text:
Alex M: Heads-up: I'm planning a coordinated load campaign tomorrow to reproduce the 99th pct tail latency regression from last week. Need quick alignment on traffic shape and canaries before we run anything.
Priya N: thanks — what's the target window and which clusters? do we mirror production or use synthetic traces?
Alex M: aiming for a 3hr window starting 09:00 PT. Primary target: hosted-prod-us-west and a single Dedicated pool for comparison. Prefer replaying sampled production traces + a synthetic k6 profile for spike phases.
Jamie L: +1 for sampled traces. if we mirror, we need a temporary rate limit on write routes. otherwise we'll blow up downstream metrics ingestion.
Taylor S: i can run a 15m smoke on staging today to validate configs. what env vars should i flip?
Priya N: config checklist: set BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=2048, ENABLE_KV_CACHE=true, kernel_variant=fast_conv, and enable prefix_cache for the replay job. also keep quantization profile at q4_0 for parity with prod.
Sam R: posting the k6 snippet we plan to use for synthetic spikes:

```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood-inference.internal/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'x'.repeat(100)}), { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
  sleep(0.25);
}
```

Sam R: we'll parameterize VUs and arrival rate. Suggest ramp: 0->500 VUs over 5m, hold 30m, spike to 1500 for 3m, then taper.
Jamie L: perf counters I'd like captured: p95/p99 latency, GPU util, NVLINK stalls, queue_depth, and kernel selection logs. can we add tracing tags for model_variant + batch_id?
Priya N: yes, runtime can emit tags. i'll add model_variant and rollout_id. also enable per-route token accounting for the run.
Alex M: perf team: can you confirm histogram buckets for tail latency? last run we missed >1200ms bucket so the p99 looked clipped.
Jamie L: we'll add 2s and 5s buckets for the histograms. also enabling extended retention for that run so SRE can pull raw samples.
Taylor S: doing staging smoke now. sharing results in ~20m. ping me if you want logs.
infra-bot: Deployment note: a short maintenance window will be created at 08:50 PT for config flips. Manual rollback available. 🛠️
Sam R: one more ask — use a reduced prompt corpus for the replay (20% of full set) to keep token volume sane, but keep distribution of short/long prompts.
Alex M: good call. ok team — final checklist: (1) Priya flips kernel/kv/cache flags, (2) Jamie enables extra buckets + tags, (3) Taylor validates staging smoke, (4) Sam primes k6 job with ramp-spike, (5) infra-bot schedules maintenance. I'll start the run and post a run-id. if anyone hits blocking errors, @here asap.
Priya N: acknowledged. i'll push config and post PR link.
Taylor S: smoke passed, small config tweak needed for env var naming (BATCH_MAX_TOKENS vs MAX_BATCH_TOKENS). fixing now.
Alex M: thanks — i'll wait for the PR and then trigger the campaign. last note: capture a small sample of KV cache hit-rate every minute so we can correlate latency to cache behavior.
